tasks.short: Record the reason and scope of the check, search public registers, check references, assess the findings, write the background report, and review it with the HR manager.

steps.what: Loss prevention specialist writes down the reason and scope of the background check: in a memo today, in the case's required fields after the change
Loss prevention specialist conducts employee background investigations by searching public registers one by one
Loss prevention specialist checks references and earlier employers by phone
Loss prevention specialist assesses the findings
Loss prevention specialist writes the background report in a document
Loss prevention specialist reviews the report with the operational or HR manager

tasks.design: Each check is opened as a case in a case register ({OTHER}) whose required fields hold the reason, scope and the least intrusive method; the specialist writes them there instead of in a memo, in about the same time. Only after those fields are filled does one search screen query the public registers in scope, such as the trade register and the insolvency register, and store the results on the case instead of searching each site by hand. The report is exported from the case with the fixed dossier fields, and the specialist writes the assessment. Reference calls, assessing findings and the review with the manager stay with the specialist.
tasks.previous_blocker: Registers were searched site by site and reports written from scratch.
tasks.enabler_now: Case registers can query public registers and export fixed-field reports.
tasks.still_hard: References are often vague or unwilling to talk.
tasks.human_edge: Weighing an old incident fairly against a candidate's record since.

reach.learn: Whether reports are complete and fair.

evidence.claim: Case registers can query public registers such as the trade register and insolvency register from one screen.
The binding privacy code fixes the case file fields: assignment, method and reason, findings, and photos.
A private investigation agency needs a Justis licence and its investigators are screened.

assumptions: Boundary: from the check requested to the report reviewed; the hiring decision is outside.
Input contract: register access arranged; fallback is searching each site.
Searches stay within the recorded scope.
HR managers' time does not change.

Recording the reason and scope (a first record), reference calls, assessing and the review keep their full time. s2 keeps 40 for reading the results and checking for name mix-ups; s5 keeps 65 because scope and register results fill in and the specialist writes the references and the assessment.
research_questions: Do searches stay within scope more often?

incremental.description: No ongoing upkeep: checking register results for name mix-ups is part of reading them in s2.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: access is arranged for only some registers and most reports turn on references and assessment (9.7); high: registers in scope are all on the search screen (20.2).

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The loss prevention specialist keeps calling references, assessing findings and reviewing reports with managers; register searches site by site and reports from scratch shrink.
skills_to_grow: Keeping searches within the recorded scope
role.ambitious_version: A specialist with more time for judgement.
